WITH status_tallies AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, tally, tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share,
         1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM status_tallies
)
SELECT archstat AS status, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > average_share;
